Tam Osei: hey everyone! Tam here — joining as a SWE on Applied ML. London-based (GMT), hybrid. I bake way too late and spin vinyls on weekends. bringing sourdough on monday if anyone wants a slice :tada:
Riley Chen: welcome Tam!! excited for sourdough. we actually have a mini bake-off in the kitchen next week — i'll DM you the signup :grin:
Kai Nakamura: welcome! rooftop jam on thurs evenings if you want to bring records, totally informal 
Lucas Park: quick logistics — remember to grab your badge from reception, bring an ID. also ping facilities for any desk requests.
DevEx-bot: Hi Tam — please complete the desk & equipment form: https://tiny.redwood/forms/desk-requests (standing desks take ~48 hrs to provision)
Tam Osei: thanks! standing desk requested. also, allergic to cilantro (tastes like soap to me) so FYI for communal lunches haha
Mira Patel: noted re: cilantro. we do a plant swap on Fridays if you want a low-maintenance plant — cacti, snake plants, etc.
Tam Osei: i'm already a proud cactus parent :cactus: perfect
Riley Chen: pro tip — there's a community vinyl crate by the kitchen, add a few favorites. i'll hunt down a record player adapter if needed.
Tam Osei: added 'Massive Attack - Mezzanine' to the crate (side A is mandatory). also happy to bring extra sourdough starter if anyone wants to bake at home.
Lucas Park: facilities replied — standing desks usually ready by Wed if form submitted today. badge will be at reception after 10am.
Mira Patel: coffee poll: french press, espresso, or instant? we have an office grinder now.
Tam Osei: french press all the way, decaf welcome after 3pm :coffee:
Riley Chen: :thumbsup: also, if you want to join the #chill-music channel for vinyl swaps, i'll add you.
welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Tam! Please check out the onboarding doc in #new-hires and join the company demo on Friday at 11am GMT.
Tam Osei: joined #chill-music and #new-hires — thanks everyone, excited to meet you in person next week!
